purpose: Freeze the minimum executable observation-only runner, primitive persistence, independent reconstruction, cluster aggregation and eliminative routing needed for the already-authorized one-shot localization workload without modifying frozen R3.
claim_ceiling: CONTROLLED_GENERATOR_INTERNAL_MECHANISM_LOCALIZATION_ONLY; FIRST_VISIBLE_LAYER_IS_NOT_CAUSAL_IDENTIFICATION; NO R3 REPAIR, PERFORMANCE, REAL_SCENE, ANDROID, PRODUCT, DANGER OR SAFETY CLAIM

authority.required_status_before_formal_launch: FROZEN_IMPLEMENTATION_READY / FROZEN_IMPLEMENTATIONS_PASS / PILOT_W1_W4_EQUIVALENCE_PASS / PREFORMAL_TEST_PASS / QUALIFIED_HOST_PREFLIGHT / BOUND_IMPLEMENTATION_READY_RECEIPT / EXISTING_R1_ACTIVATION

implementation_bindings.finalization_rule: All three reviewed files are frozen to the exact SHA-256 values above. Formal launch still requires a separate implementation-ready receipt binding this spec, all three files, the final pilot equivalence receipt, the preformal test receipt and the qualified host preflight before any formal target-root claim or sealed localization-input access.

execution_shape.formal_output_root_write_policy: Atomic exclusive root claim followed by per-cluster staging and atomic rename; no overwrite, resume, merge, replacement or deletion-and-retry.

observation_hook_contract.principle: Patch only symbols imported into the R3 pair-core module or the defining module's native primitive during a synchronous pair call; call the original exactly once, copy observation values, return the original value unchanged, and restore every patch before leaving the pair scope.

required_hooks.capture: Exact float32 row order, previous-frame coordinates, fixed 3x3 cell and requested count.
Warped gray and valid-mask content hashes, overlap, common/interior/boundary counts and full-support residual summaries; full frames need not be persisted.

required_hooks.symbol: track_features plus a call-through spy on its defining module cv2.calcOpticalFlowPyrLK
required_hooks.capture: For the compensated R3 track call used by the FLOW source-error primitive: forward endpoint/status, best available backward endpoint and level, backward availability, FB error and <=1 px pass, rounded compensated-mask sample and accepted source indices without executing an extra native LK call. Raw-track behavior remains represented by the unchanged native raw/final-fit consensus audit, not by a second persisted LK-stage family.

Carry and supplement diagnostics, accepted identities, deterministic baseline/carry/supplement path class, duplicate suppression, managed result and PairState survivor identity before and after the pair.

required_hooks.symbol: fit_fixed_grid_local_affine plus a call-through spy on its defining module _consensus_mask
required_hooks.capture: All native fit-call inputs and outputs plus exact per-cell RANSAC consensus indices. The runner recomputes an audit-only float64 OLS on the exact consensus support.

fit_call_order.final_cell_splice: For each activated cell use its managed fit input and native fit output; for each non-activated cell use its initial fit input and native fit output. Apply the same rule separately to raw and compensated paths.

observation_hook_contract.mutation_prohibition: The runner must assert that the R3 row, PairState and every original return value are identical to an uninstrumented nonsealed fixture call. Observation hooks have no scientific decision authority.

sampling_and_numeric_contract.pixel_sampling: All common-valid pixels in row-major order; no random, stratified or response-dependent pixel subsampling.
sampling_and_numeric_contract.track_sampling: All frozen native candidates or accepted tracks eligible for the named primitive; no thinning, balancing, replacement or response-dependent selection.
sampling_and_numeric_contract.source_correspondence: Raycast each previous/source point to finite source-known depth, object identity and world point; project the identical material point at the current pose, require bilinear-safe same-object z-buffer visibility within the frozen tolerance, and map that current projection through inv(H_previous_to_current) into the R3 aligned frame.
sampling_and_numeric_contract.invalid_source_correspondence: Store a finite reason code and source index. Do not store a fabricated coordinate, zero response, NaN or infinity and do not include the point in a fit.
sampling_and_numeric_contract.json_numeric: UTF-8 sorted-key compact canonical JSON with LF and finite numbers only; unavailable scientific scalars are null only when paired with a frozen abstention reason.
sampling_and_numeric_contract.array_numeric: NPZ arrays use explicit non-object dtypes and allow_pickle=false on read. Ragged missingness uses offsets and source-index arrays, never NaN or zero-fill.
sampling_and_numeric_contract.percentile_formula: Sort finite values x[0..n-1]; h=(n-1)*p, j=floor(h), g=h-j; Q(p)=(1-g)*x[j]+g*x[min(j+1,n-1)]. n=0 is unavailable and n=1 returns x[0].

erosion_kernel.semantic: All pixels within Chebyshev radius 10 must be valid; constant-zero border also enforces distance >10 px from the image edge.

boundary_strata_contract.track_stratum_assignment: Assign by the previous/source track coordinate using the frozen nearest-pixel sampling rule; a point outside common is ineligible.
boundary_strata_contract.pair_support: Boundary and interior are independently fit and retain separate boundary_evaluable and interior_evaluable flags and finite summaries when available. The matched boundary primitive pair gate is evaluable only when both flags are true; all cluster comparisons use this joint fixed-denominator gate. One stratum becoming unavailable never erases the other stratum's persisted evidence and never imputes a matched pair.

cluster_states.MASK_PASS: Both boundary and interior absolute type-7 P90 are <=0.01/s.
cluster_states.BOUNDARY_ONLY_FAIL: Boundary absolute type-7 P90 is >0.01/s, interior is <=0.01/s, and both strata meet all coverage and finite-value requirements.
cluster_states.MASK_NONSEPARABLE: Both strata are evaluable but the interior absolute type-7 P90 is >0.01/s, regardless of the boundary value.
cluster_states.NOT_EVALUABLE: Either stratum lacks required support, pair coverage or a required finite primitive.

five_layer_primitive_contract.pair_primitive: Use source-valid previous-frame initial feature sites and their exact source-known current projections aligned by inv(H). In each 3x3 cell run float64 OLS on all eligible source-known displacements without RANSAC rejection.
five_layer_primitive_contract.cell_evaluable: At least 12 sites, hull fraction >=0.10, finite design condition <=1000 and median OLS residual <=0.75 px/frame.
five_layer_primitive_contract.pair_signed: median of evaluable cell signed expansion.
five_layer_primitive_contract.pair_absolute: median of abs(evaluable cell signed expansion).
five_layer_primitive_contract.cluster_gate: Maximum homogeneous H then inv(H) round-trip residual across evaluable pairs <=1e-9 px AND cluster absolute type-7 P90 <=0.01/s.

five_layer_primitive_contract.pair_primitive: Compute homogeneous coordinate round-trip P99 over all common pixel centers, signed and absolute normalized gray summaries over all interior pixels, and overlap/interior-support fractions.
five_layer_primitive_contract.pair_evaluable: overlap_fraction >=0.75 AND interior_count/previous_valid_count >=0.75 with finite nonempty primitives.
five_layer_primitive_contract.pair_signed: Interior signed normalized gray P50 and P90 are descriptive and stored separately.
five_layer_primitive_contract.pair_absolute: Interior absolute normalized gray P50, P90 and P99.
five_layer_primitive_contract.cluster_gate: Type-7 P90 of pair coordinate-round-trip P99 <=1e-6 px AND type-7 P90 of pair interior absolute-gray P90 <=1/255. Pair overlap and interior support below 0.75 are abstentions, not zero responses.
five_layer_primitive_contract.early_abstention_persistence: If unchanged R3 exits before tracking because overlap is below 0.75, persist the exact R3 abstention reason, zero captured track calls, and the fixed 4 fit groups, 2 merge groups and 18 raw/compensated final consensus groups as typed empty arrays. The independent validator must reconstruct the warp and accept only this exact structural absence.

five_layer_primitive_contract.pair_primitive: On final-managed compensated tracks, independently fit source-error expansion in boundary and interior strata using all eligible source-error tracks and the audit-only 3x3 OLS support contract without RANSAC rejection.
five_layer_primitive_contract.cell_evaluable: At least 12 tracks, hull fraction >=0.10, finite design condition <=1000 and median OLS residual <=0.75 px/frame.
five_layer_primitive_contract.pair_evaluable: At least 5 evaluable cells in each stratum.
five_layer_primitive_contract.pair_signed: Per stratum median evaluable cell signed source-error expansion.
five_layer_primitive_contract.pair_absolute: Per stratum median abs(evaluable cell signed source-error expansion).
five_layer_primitive_contract.cluster_gate: Use one matched pair set where both boundary_evaluable and interior_evaluable are true. Require >=451 matched pairs, compute both stratum type-7 P90 values on that identical set, then apply MASK_PASS, BOUNDARY_ONLY_FAIL, MASK_NONSEPARABLE or NOT_EVALUABLE. Individual stratum counts remain transparency evidence only.

five_layer_primitive_contract.pair_primitive: Separately fit source-error expansion for compensated initial-accepted tracks and the exact final-managed compensated track collection using all eligible tracks and the audit-only 3x3 OLS support contract without RANSAC rejection.
five_layer_primitive_contract.cell_evaluable: At least 12 tracks, hull fraction >=0.10, finite design condition <=1000 and median OLS residual <=0.75 px/frame.
five_layer_primitive_contract.pair_evaluable: Each initial-accepted and final-managed subprimitive independently needs at least 5 evaluable cells. Their pair cohorts may differ and are not used as a paired contrast; the layer is evaluable only when both independent fixed-denominator coverage gates pass.
five_layer_primitive_contract.pair_signed: For each primitive, median evaluable cell signed source-error expansion.
five_layer_primitive_contract.pair_absolute: For each primitive, median abs(evaluable cell signed source-error expansion).
five_layer_primitive_contract.cluster_gate: On their separately retained pair cohorts, both initial-accepted and final-managed subprimitives independently need >=451/601 pairs and cluster absolute type-7 P90 <=0.01/s. One or both scientific failures remain FLOW_FAIL within the same layer; missing coverage in either primitive is NOT_EVALUABLE. No accepted-versus-managed paired-difference claim is made.

five_layer_primitive_contract.pair_primitive: Use exact native raw and compensated tracked support, exact captured native RANSAC consensus, independently reconstructed float32-ledger scientific reductions, activated-cell splice and unchanged raw/compensated common cells. Audit coefficient matrices must be finite 3x2 and exactly self-consistent with the frozen trace expansion formula under the bound numeric-representation amendment; scientific equality is carried by independently reconstructed expansion, residual, condition and reductions rather than cross-process coefficient bit identity.
five_layer_primitive_contract.pair_evaluable: The unchanged R3 row is evaluable and at least 5 raw/compensated common cells are independently reproduced.
five_layer_primitive_contract.pair_signed: median of compensated signed expansion across independently reproduced common cells.
five_layer_primitive_contract.pair_absolute: median of abs(compensated common-cell signed expansion), never abs(median(signed)).
five_layer_primitive_contract.cluster_gate: Every native cell and pair reduction reproduces R3 within the frozen numeric tolerance, at least 451/601 pairs are evaluable, and cluster absolute type-7 P90 <=0.01/s.
five_layer_primitive_contract.reproduction_mismatch: INVALID / NOT_EVALUABLE, not scientific LOCAL_FIT localization.

pair_to_cluster_aggregation.cluster_signed: Type-7 P50 and P90 over ordered evaluable pair-signed values.
pair_to_cluster_aggregation.cluster_absolute: Type-7 P90 over ordered evaluable pair-absolute values.
pair_to_cluster_aggregation.warp_nested_reduction: Compute the named percentile over all eligible pixels within each pair, then compute type-7 P90 across evaluable pair primitives within the cluster.
pair_to_cluster_aggregation.coverage_rule: Each required layer needs >=451/601 evaluable ordered pairs. MASK_BOUNDARY is the explicit matched-cohort exception: both stratum values use the same >=451-pair intersection, while separate individual counts remain descriptive. FLOW accepted and managed retain independent >=451-pair cohorts and are not interpreted as a paired contrast. Missing pairs remain missing; no zero fill, interpolation, denominator change, rescue pooling or cross-layer substitution.

three_pair.role: Reproduce and report unchanged R3 state only; it does not replace absolute-leakage routing.

route_precedence.precondition: The unchanged final R3 output is independently reproduced, has >=451/601 evaluable pairs, and its cluster absolute type-7 P90 is strictly >0.01/s. A value <=0.01/s has no leakage to localize and routes NOT_EVALUABLE.

ordered_rules.if: Any binding, schema, identity, source input, finite-value, pair order, required primitive, required stratum, >=451 coverage, hook transparency, R3 reproduction, resource or write-once condition is unavailable or invalid.
ordered_rules.note: Protocol-invalid execution may stop without a scientific route; it must never be converted into MULTIPLE_SOURCES_NOT_SEPARABLE.

ordered_rules.if: INPUT_GEOMETRY is evaluable and fails its cluster gate.
ordered_rules.note: Downstream signals cannot override the earliest geometry failure.

ordered_rules.if: Geometry passes, ROTATION_WARP is evaluable and fails, while MASK_PASS and both required FLOW primitives pass.
Geometry passes and ROTATION_WARP fails, but an independently evaluable mask or flow source-error primitive also fails.
Geometry and warp pass, mask state is BOUNDARY_ONLY_FAIL, and the interior final-managed flow primitive passes.
Geometry and warp pass, but mask state is MASK_NONSEPARABLE, or BOUNDARY_ONLY_FAIL co-occurs with an interior flow failure.
Geometry, warp and mask pass, and either initial-accepted or final-managed FLOW primitive is evaluable and fails.
ordered_rules.note: Disagreement between the two flow subprimitives is a within-layer subtype, not a cross-layer MULTIPLE route.

ordered_rules.if: All four earlier layers pass, native local/final values are independently reproduced, and final R3 cluster absolute type-7 P90 remains >0.01/s.

output_contract.root_creation: After every pre-claim check passes and immediately before first sealed localization-input access, write claim.json inside a unique sibling staging directory and atomically rename that directory to the exact formal output root. The formal root therefore never becomes visible without its exclusive claim. Existing root or rename collision is a non-consuming output collision.
output_contract.runner_directory_policy: staging/ and progress/ are created after claim. Each staging/<cluster_id> directory is atomically renamed to clusters/<cluster_id>; successful completion leaves staging empty. Numbered progress records are authoritative write-once evidence; progress.json is a replaceable operational latest-state sidecar and never has scientific decision authority.
output_contract.formal_claim_required_bindings: The formal claim stores safe repository-relative paths and SHA-256 values for the executable spec, implementation-ready receipt and host-preflight receipt, plus runner, activation, contract, identity, protocol and source bindings. The independent validator reopens and rehashes these paths, its own implementation binding, the pilot/test receipts and every file under spec.bindings before scientific replay.
output_contract.validator_file_policy: analysis_result.json and independent_validation_receipt.json are exclusive write-once outputs. Exactly one of execution_decision.json or validation_failure.json closes formal validation. validation_progress.json is an operational replaceable sidecar created for every non-validate-only execution, including disjoint pilot mechanics and formal validation, and has no scientific decision authority. Its initial total equals the bound run cluster count, sample_index is monotone, pair-loop heartbeats refresh it at most every 5 seconds, success closes status=complete, and an owned formal failure preserves counts while closing status=failed. Only the process that won the exclusive progress claim may write validation_failure, and decision creation rechecks that failure is absent.

pair_ledger_jsonl_schema.ordering: pair_index exactly 0..600 with no duplicate, gap or reorder
pair_ledger_jsonl_schema.cell_audit_storage: Raw and compensated final-fit cell audits, exact native-consensus reproduction and abstention reasons are embedded under local_affine_and_final_aggregation in the ordered pair row; there is no separate cell_ledger.jsonl.
pair_ledger_jsonl_schema.missing_semantic: Unavailable pair primitives store evaluable=false, exact support counts and null scientific scalars; cell-level failures additionally store frozen abstention reasons. Missing keys or zero-filled scientific scalars are invalid.

primitives_npz_schema.ragged_indexing: Every variable-length family has int64 pair offsets of length 602 and explicit integer source indices.
primitives_npz_schema.initial_cell_rule: initial_previous stores exact feature row order; the fixed 3x3 cell is deterministically reconstructed from the frozen image shape and coordinate bounds rather than duplicated.
primitives_npz_schema.lk_scope: The lk_* family is the compensated R3 track call used for FLOW localization. fit_* stores four ordered groups per pair: RAW_INITIAL, COMPENSATED_INITIAL, RAW_MANAGED and COMPENSATED_MANAGED; absent managed refits are explicit empty groups. activated_* stores the ordered unique activated cells. merge_* stores two ordered candidate groups per pair, RAW_MANAGED and COMPENSATED_MANAGED. The validator must reconstruct both selected merge outputs, the activated-cell initial/managed splice, final managed provenance, and the exact raw/compensated RANSAC consensus before accepting pair-ledger cell audits.

cluster_metrics_json_schema.decision_critical_independent_replay: The independent validator requires the exact top-level keyset and independently matches every layer status plus evaluable counts and route-bearing P90/max values for geometry, warp, matched mask-boundary, accepted/managed FLOW, local fit and final R3. Descriptive extra reductions remain hash-bound but have no routing authority.

output_contract.receipt_hashing: Each cluster receipt binds the exact SHA-256 of pair_ledger.jsonl, primitives.npz and cluster_metrics.json. The run receipt binds every cluster receipt, implementation-ready receipt, executable spec, host preflight, activation, contract, identity lock, resource telemetry and formal firewalls.

fixture.identity_rule: Pilot tokens, seeds, scenes, poses and render-input hashes must use a PILOT_ONLY namespace and be disjoint from every formal identity-input-lock value. The pilot is not a prefix, suffix, subset, slice, truncation, projection or derived identity of any of the 8 sealed clusters.
fixture.mechanics_equivalence_only: Exercise the same observation hooks, primitive persistence, independent reconstruction, pair-to-cluster reductions and W1/W4 scheduling semantics without loading or interpreting any formal identity-lock payload.

pilot_w1_w4_equivalence.storage: Caller-supplied ephemeral non-target directories; the formal output root, identity-lock payload and sealed Stage B response paths are forbidden.
equivalence_payload: Every primitive array dtype, shape and canonical raw-content digest
Pair ledgers including embedded raw/compensated cell audits
All pair-to-cluster reductions, coverage, layer states and independent pilot routes
Hook call counts, managed path provenance, activated-cell splice and PairState semantic digest
pilot_w1_w4_equivalence.comparison: Exact equality after canonical removal of allowed operational fields; numeric tolerances, reordered arrays, changed abstentions or changed routes are forbidden.
pilot_w1_w4_equivalence.validator_rule: The independent validator must validate both pilots separately and then produce one exclusive W1_W4_EQUIVALENCE_PASS receipt binding both semantic digests and implementation source hashes.
pilot_w1_w4_equivalence.pilot_retry: Pilot-only implementation fixtures may be rerun before implementation binding; formal identities and the formal target root remain untouched.
pilot_w1_w4_equivalence.mode_separation: PILOT mode must reject any attempt to load the 8-cluster identity lock or a formal cluster identifier. FORMAL mode alone may load exactly the 8 frozen clusters after all bindings, pilot receipt, resource checks and exclusive-claim preconditions pass.

required_exact_bindings: pilot_w1_w4_equivalence receipt_path, receipt_sha256, semantic_payload_sha256, pilot_manifest_sha256, status PASS and workers [1,4]
preformal_test_gate receipt_path, receipt_sha256, test_count, test_suite_sha256 and status PASS
implementation_ready_receipt_contract.authority_rule: This receipt binds implementation readiness only. It cannot replace or expand the existing R1 activation.

host_preflight_contract.implementation: Exact runner repository-relative path and final SHA-256.
host_preflight_contract.guarded_launcher: Exact scripts/run_guarded_host_research.ps1 path and launch-time SHA-256.

scheduler.estimated_gib_per_worker: Positive value derived conservatively from final W4 pilot.

independent_validator_scope.source_independence: Must not import the runner, R3 pair core, tracking, support-manager evaluation or local-fit implementation. It may read their frozen hashes and consume persisted primitives.
required_reconstruction: All contract, activation, identity, implementation, input and output hashes
Frame reconstruction and gray/valid/warped content hashes from frozen generated inputs
Float64 homography, source projection, visibility and source-error geometry
21x21 erosion boundary/interior masks and all pixel summaries
LK forward/backward/FB/mask stage accounting from captured native endpoints and statuses
Deterministic baseline/carry/supplement merge provenance and activated-cell final splice

Exact native consensus and independently reconstructed float32-ledger scientific reductions; audit coefficient matrices must be finite 3x2 and exactly self-consistent with the frozen trace expansion formula under the bound numeric-representation amendment, while residual, condition, expansion, common-cell and pair reductions are independently replayed
Raw/compensated common cells, signed and absolute pair values
Manual Hyndman-Fan type-7 cluster reductions and 451/601 coverage
Strict >0.01/s three-pair state with abstention reset
Every layer state and the ordered per-cluster route
independent_validator_scope.native_ransac_check: Before formal launch, tests must establish repeatable exact consensus on the nonsealed pilot. During validation, any captured-consensus inconsistency or independent native-consensus mismatch is INVALID rather than a local-fit scientific route.
independent_validator_scope.final_route_writer: Only the independent validator writes the final per-cluster routes and overall execution decision.

required_tests: median(abs(cell)) differs from abs(median(cell)) and only the former is accepted
Manual Hyndman-Fan type-7 matches frozen reference vectors including n=1 and interpolation
451/601 passes and 450/601 fails every required coverage gate
21x21 square erosion has exact radius-10 edge and invalid-boundary behavior with no off-by-one
Gray residual sign is warped-current minus previous and absolute summaries remain separate
Strict response >0.01/s excludes equality and abstention resets the three-pair streak
Forward, backward-available, FB<=1, mask-pass and accepted stage mutations are detected
Managed baseline/carry/supplement provenance and duplicate order mutations are detected
Activated cells select managed fit inputs and non-activated cells select initial fit inputs
Exact consensus, audit-coefficient shape/formula, independently reconstructed residual/expansion, common-cell and pair-reduction mutations are detected
Every route-precedence branch is covered, including missing=>NOT_EVALUABLE and scientific cofailure=>MULTIPLE
R3 return-value or PairState mutation by an observation hook is detected
Nonfinite JSON or array values, object arrays, offset gaps and pair reordering fail
Output collision, binding drift, memory stop, paging stop and worker residue fail closed
PILOT_W1 and PILOT_W4 produce exact equivalent semantic payloads

resource_and_firewall.sustained_paging: Two consecutive coordinator telemetry intervals with positive swap-in plus swap-out delta.

preclaim_nonconsuming_stops: A frozen implementation binding, preformal gate, host preflight or implementation-ready receipt is absent or hash-mismatched.
Pilot W1/W4 equivalence receipt is absent, invalid or hash-mismatched.
Any frozen binding, activation, identity, source, coordinate, parameter or validator hash drifts.
Formal output root or claim already exists.
Available RAM is below 6 GiB before launch or worker refill.
A forbidden formal path, Stage B write path or live residual worker is detected.
formal_one_shot_stop_rules.claim_boundary: Atomically creating the formal output root and execution claim occurs immediately before first sealed localization-input access. Either successful claim creation or first sealed input access consumes the sole formal attempt.
postclaim_immediate_stops: Available RAM falls below 4 GiB while workers are in flight.
Any worker exits unexpectedly, times out or leaves residue.
Any nonfinite primitive, schema mismatch, pair/order/cardinality mismatch, hook call-order mismatch or R3 return mutation occurs.
Any write collision, partial-cluster final-path collision, formal firewall drift or source/input hash drift occurs.
formal_one_shot_stop_rules.complete_execution: Exactly 8 clusters, 8 sequences and 4808 ordered pairs must atomically close before run_receipt.json is written.
formal_one_shot_stop_rules.independent_validation: Run once against the closed write-once runner payload. A validator failure or reconstruction mismatch cannot authorize a workload rerun and cannot be repaired by changing scientific data, gates or routing.
formal_one_shot_stop_rules.after_route: No R3 change, retry, identity replacement, reseed, coverage repair, Stage B rerun or single-variable candidate is authorized. Any future candidate requires a separate contract, calibration, activation and new successor evidence.
